reviews.t: Great polish and great deal! Even you get repeats!
reviews.x: UPDATE 5/3/21: Got my second shipment today. All in tact! And great color selection!  This is a really great deal. If it is packaged right. The first time, unfortunately the bottles arrived smashed due to poor packaging. This is not the vendors fault as it was shipped by Amazon. I told them about it and they gave me a full refund. I really wish they would take a little more care when shipping. Hopefully my next round will go better. **UPDATE**  5/3/21: Got my second shipment today. All in tact!

I contacted Paula at Makeup Planet to see if I could get the colors I wanted of these nail polishes instead of getting just a random batch.  She told me absolutely and just to email her the colors I chose.  I went to the Sallly Hansen website and picked 20 colors, then I emailed them to Paula.  In just a short time, she had sent me the package with every single color I'd requested.  Paula really went out of her way to help me, and i have never received such phenomenal customer service from any s

Price for the amount of nail polish you get you can’t beat. It’s a little nerve racking that you can’t select colors and have to just hope that you don’t get duplicates. I at least got more than 10 different colors. Only 2 of them were duplicates but some of them are only a shade off so they do look almost the same color. The only thing that I would recommend be changed with whoever picks out the colors is that there is more variety in the different colors you get so it doesn’t feel like you rec

I got my lot today and I'm SO happy with it!  I knew it was a risk being unable to select the colors myself but I'm pretty thrilled with the colors that arrived.  There were no duplicates (which I was concerned about) and while there are three dark blues that are somewhat similar, there are enough differences in the bottles to make them unique.  I had two of the colors already but considering I have about 15 of this brand already getting only 2 that I already owned was amazing!  All in all, this

everything was duplicated so only got like 10 colors then one of the bottles was half open and spilled in box and the brush was broke off in the polish and it was not packaged well at all not very happy

This brand of Sally Hansen nail polish is my absolute fav. I love the brush as in one single swipe , bam you have covered your nail. The polish is always so smooth  in texture with every color they make. This has turned out to be the best purchase I have ever made at Amazon. What a value. Yes there were one or two repeats but they turned out to be the colors I use the most. Go figure, YAY!!!!!!!!
I purchased from seller Golden Gol. I am so happy with this purchase. All 20 of mine were different colors, with only a couple being a similar shade of color. Very well worth the money.

I got these as a gift, and my set actually came with 21 bottles. No repeats, but there were a few similar colors, but they were colors I know I will use. There were some of my favorites, and some of what I am sure will be my new favorites :) very happy!

I drove to a retail pharmacy to see their current stock.  This polish runs $6 to $17 depending on who you order it from.  With this order I got 20 bottle, only one repeat.The assortment I got was pinks, purples, tans and a white.  The polish is a good quality, stays on my frequently washed hands for around three days with no chipping, just a little wear at the edges of the nails. Picture one is three days after applying, one 12 hour shift included. These are the colors I received: you glow girl,

reviews.t: That I would receive all the bottles with the least amount of duplicates.
reviews.x: I was happy with the Sally Hanson nail polish, but upon delivery one bottle broke and smeared all over the box and on 8 of the bottles. I did get 2 colors that were the same. The broken bottle wasn't Sally's fault..I still love her products. I especially love the diamond brand.

reviews.t: ITS A LIE, DO NOT PURCHASE!
reviews.x: 5 of the colors were so close they looked the same! See the pictures and judge for yourself. Very ugly colors, these are the left overs that no one wants to buy.

reviews.t: Beautiful polishes..NO REPEATS in my 20 pieces :-)
reviews.x: Seller responded right away and was VERY helpful.  Great deal!

I don’t mind the duplicate since people did mention that may happen. I planned on giving extra to a friend. I was pleased with the price for the amount you get for sally hansen brand , so I took the chance.  The odor is why I wouldn’t recommend. It doesn’t smell like a nail polish odor more like when you buy glitter paint. It has a strong unpleasant smell. I have my windows open with the heat on haha. 3 bottles the color/ oil didn’t mix but I didn’t mind tossing it since I had 22 more to chose f

reviews.t: Minor cosmetic scratches on bottles, but no duplicates and great variety of colors
reviews.x: So pleased with this purchase!  I had read the other reviews and prepared to receive a bunch of duplicates, but was pleasantly surprised to see none.  I got a good assortment of colors: neutrals (blushes, pinks), reds, a few out of the box (blue and sparkly) and even a base coat (Cleared for take-off) which I was going to purchase separately so I'm thrilled to have gotten it here. Overall a good combination of matte's and metallic colors.  A superb deal for only $1 a bottle!  Here are the colors

I was open to getting any colors (because I love iridescent top coats to alter colors) and I was happy to receive good polish with a quality nail brush for the price. However, 2 sets of TRIPLICATES (Ginger Zinger and Rose to the Occasion), 3 sets of DUPLICATES (World is My Oyster, Red My Lips, Pat on the Back), and a yellowed top coat (ironically called Clear for Takeoff) is simply unacceptable. This product is being FALSELY ADVERTISED as a set without duplicates. Buyer beware!

[[VIDEOID:ab113a46fedfb7e7695dc1382ce9797f]] I was worried after reading that some people received broken bottles, but mine came packaged carefully and safely and arrived in perfect condition. The outer box had cushioning as well as the lining of the inner box. I only got one repeat--the clear polish. One of them is a little yellowed but all the other bottles are wonderful. Really, really happy I chose to purchase!

reviews.t: Eh.. not the best colors but some good ones
reviews.x: Lots of duplicates… and triplicates (is that a word?) I knew I’d get some but it was more than expected. The price is still not terrible (considering you can’t choose your own colors) even if I only get 10 different colors for $20. Then I counted them all and there were only 19. Supposed to be 20.  So I talked to Amazon customer service and they actually refunded me. I didn’t expect that but appreciated it.

I received a nice assortment of colors.  I did receive three duplicates in my order of twenty.  The cap of one bottle was slightly loose, so there was a small amount of spillage (less than a teaspoon).  The polish’s I have tried applied evenly.  The wide brush worked well for me; it seemed helpful for applying with my left hand onto my dominant right hand.

I have always like Sally Hansen nail polish. However the bundle of 25 nail polish arrived upside down. One of the red polishes had spilled. Fortunately it leaked only on to the plastic in the box. I had to throw out the one nail polish. With liquid merchandise, you would think that the factory would encase these little bottles separately in plastic.

I received many wonderful colors with no repeats but the bottles were shipped poorly. They were randomly arranged in a box that was too small so that the lid was bulging. Several bottles were leaking and it took about 15 minutes and lots of nail polish remover to clean up the bottles. It was still a great value and a fun way to try new colors.

reviews.t: Outstanding Quality and Price So Afffordable
reviews.x: I received a nice variety of colors in the three orders I have made. There are a few bright reds and numerous whites that sometimes that I could live without.  Every package contains at least 50% of nail colors I really enjoy wearing. What a GREAT value for the money. The nail polish wear time is excellent also. Outstanding quality purchase.

Took a chance on this nail polish. I used Sally Hansens nail polish for years and I just can’t find this particular one in the store anymore. So I ordered this set of 20 nail polishes and I was not disappointed! I only received doubles of two colors and the rest came with our wonderful assortment of lights and dark colors. Worth a try

Some of the shades are similar, but I do not care. I love that I had many year round colours and neutrals. I appreciated getting topcoats. I had two repeats, but it does not bother me; the possibility of repeats was listed in the description. All these polishes for twenty bucks is less than the cost of a pedicure.

Did not like that had two or more of the same colors thought they would all be different, will end up giving over half away I am 62 and do not wear black nail polish  which I got 3 of nor will I wear the dark blues which also had 3 , will be ordering differently next time I order polish

reviews.t: You take your chances, description says may have duplicates though.
reviews.x: This is the second set I've ordered for my wife. The first she got 20 different colors and they were all different. This time she only got 15 colors. Three doubles and a triple. Little disappointed with this order but she loves this brand of polish. And likes almost all the colors.

claims.text: Many reviewers report receiving few or no duplicate colors and praise the color variety, though some received duplicates or near-identical shades.
Reviewers widely consider the set an excellent value for the price given the number of Sally Hansen bottles received.
Several reviewers mention packaging or shipping problems, including broken, spilled, or damaged bottles.
Some reviewers were unhappy about being unable to select colors and receiving duplicates or unwanted shades.
Reviewers praise the polish quality, smooth texture, and good brush.
